skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strips [Undying] from the target's entire column, then deals 50% ATK Direct DMG plus Extra Direct DMG equal to 14% ATK to that column.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Additionally grants self +30% Crit and +30% Crit DMG. Direct DMG to the column 50% > 60% ATK, and the Extra Direct DMG 14% > 18% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% HP. On entry, gains [Max HP Up] raising Max HP by 100% and gains undispellable [Immunity]. At the start of each round, heals for 50% of Max HP. At the start of his turn, cleanses [Stun] from 2 allies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Round-start heal 70% > 90% of Max HP. [Stun] cleanse targets 2 > 3 allies.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, summons 1 crow (400% of Gouketsu's original HP). One of them will share 85% damage for allies in Gouketsu's row. After consuming all HP, deals EXTRA DMG by 30% of its Max HP to 3 random enemies which are not in any [Unyielding] state. Reduces main target's [Enhanced Unyielding] state by 2 actions.

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Survival status keeps the bearer alive by drastically reducing damage taken (e.g. only taking 20%).
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Status that causes the bearer to be unaffected by a certain effect or type of control, such as [Breakthrough], Stun, or Charm.
